description: bits-ui's Select compiled from its published source through shadcn-svelte's unmodified select wrappers and the select-demo (a single select of five fruits in a labelled group, given as items, bound to a value, with a hidden input named favoriteFruit). Opened by a press on the trigger (the first item highlighted), the pointer over an item (highlighted), a press on it selecting it and closing the content with the trigger showing its label; reopened by ArrowDown (the selected item highlighted), arrow keys through the items (not looping), Enter selecting one; a typed letter selecting the next item it starts while closed (the typeahead of the items); Space opening and Escape closing; a press on the trigger opening and a press outside closing (`covered`). The portal, floating-ui positioning of the content below the trigger, data-state, data-highlighted and data-selected, the check indicator, the open and close animations
